import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    chars = list(s)
    count = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(chars):
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(chars) and chars[j] == chars[i]:
            j += 1
        if ((j - i) & 1) == 0:
            count += 1
        i = j
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
